en: The image is a black-and-white photograph showing a rural or semi-rural landscape with a mountainous backdrop. In the foreground, there are four people—three adults and one child—standing on rocky terrain. Behind them, dense trees and vegetation can be seen, along with a few visible white buildings that look like houses or villas. The postcard features Greek text and a watermark from elia.org.gr.
